q: Which king is behind the building of, among other things, the Round Tower and Rosenborg Castle in Copenhagen?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2021 exam.

da.q: Hvilken konge står bag opførelsen af blandt andet Rundetårn og Rosenborg Slot i København?

learn.text: Absalon built a castle in 1167; the king took the town over from Roskilde's bishop in 1416. Christian the Fourth's reign, 1588 to 1648, made Copenhagen a European city. The Round Tower, from 1642, is 41.55 metres high with a 200-metre spiral walkway; Rosenborg was finished in 1634; the Stock Exchange in 1640, with the Dragon Spire, half destroyed by fire in April 2024; Nyboder was decided in 1631.

q: On which of the following days of observance does the head of state give a speech every year to the whole realm community? The exam says the queen; today it is the king.
appeared: It appeared in the June 2021 exam.

da.q: På hvilken af følgende mærkedage holder dronningen hvert år en tale til hele rigsfællesskabet?

learn.text: It is from his reception room in one of the mansions that the king every New Year's Eve, nytårsaften, at 6 pm gives his New Year's speech to the whole realm community.

q: Which historic building in Copenhagen burned on the sixteenth of April 2024?
appeared: It appeared in the May 2024 exam.

da.q: Hvilken historisk bygning i København brændte den 16. april 2024?

learn.text: The king wanted to make Copenhagen a European trading centre, and therefore he built the Stock Exchange, Børsen, which was finished in 1640.

q: In which castle in Copenhagen does the king and his family live part of the year?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2025 exam.

da.q: På hvilket slot i København bor kongen og hans familie en del af året?

learn.text: Older exams said the queen; the answer is New Year's Eve, not Christmas Eve and not Constitution Day. Amalienborg is where the king and family live; Rosenborg is a museum for the crown jewels.
